description: QA scene: a modern, bright office kitchenette. Two characters, no names and no gendered pronouns in the dialogue: only the voices (and the picture) tell who is a man and who is a woman, and so who is spoken to.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Hey, did you grab my coffee from the counter?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yeah, I left it right next to your notebook.

notes: Line times are the speech spans of the audio (silence at 0-1.38s and 8.28-10.03s). Measured median voice pitch: A about 123 Hz, B about 239 Hz.
